needed.evidence: Footway is narrow (<1m) with potential obstructions and trip hazards; people must walk in the carriageway and on informal paths.
needed.suggestion: Extend and pave the footway to at least 3 meters width from the edge of the driving lane on the right side, ensuring its usability and free from obstructions.

needed.evidence: Partial obstruction seen on narrow footway on the right side.
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the under-1m footway on the right side to ensure it is functional and accessible for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections of the footway on the right side pose trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the uneven sections of the footway on the right side to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: No crossing facility is visible despite pedestrian demand, and people are crossing the carriageway.
needed.suggestion: Introduce a marked pedestrian crossing with refuge on this busy, multi-lane road to provide a safe crossing for pedestrians and improve road safety.

needed.evidence: Wide road with no refuge for pedestrians crossing midway.
needed.suggestion: Install a refuge island on this wide road to provide a safe midway crossing point for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No visible kerb ramps for accessibility at the current informal crossing location.
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at crossing points to accommodate accessibility for all pedestrians, including those using wheelchairs or mobility devices.

needed.evidence: Urban area with limited street lighting, particularly noticeable near the high pedestrian activity zones.
needed.suggestion: Install ample street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and motorists, especially in high-traffic and high-activity zones.
